title: The take-home exercise: scope, time spent and what to hand in

videos.script: Some processes send you home with an exercise: build this small thing, fix this broken setup, write this script, and send it back in a few days. {{what}} It is the closest the process gets to real work, and it is where juniors lose the most time, because nobody tells them when to stop. {{time}} A take-home is graded on less than you think, and on different things. {{graded}} This lesson reads the brief, decides how much time to spend, hands in something a reviewer can check in ten minutes, and says when an exercise is not worth doing at all.
